text:
rachel: Hit a weird one on WSL2 — installed redwoodctl with Homebrew on Debian/WSL and my `redwoodctl local serve` says profile not found even though `redwoodctl profile list` shows it. Also `redwoodctl login` opens the Windows browser but the device code never completes.

omar: Hmm. Are you invoking the Linux binary under WSL or the Windows one via PATH shim? `which redwoodctl` and `ls -l $(which redwoodctl)` please.

rachel: `which redwoodctl` -> `/usr/local/bin/redwoodctl` which is a symlink to `/home/rachel/.linuxbrew/bin/redwoodctl`. `readlink -f $(which redwoodctl)` -> `/mnt/c/Program Files/Redwood/redwoodctl.exe` !!

ben: Ah that explains it. Homebrew created a shim that points to the Windows exe when the Windows installer is present; the Windows exe uses a different profile directory (`%APPDATA%\Redwood`) so WSL shows no profiles. The browser open is the Windows browser which can't complete device flow back into WSL.

rachel: How do I force using the Linux binary?

omar: Two options: 1) Reinstall the Linux tarball into /usr/local and ensure /usr/local/bin/redwoodctl points to the ELF binary (`file $(readlink -f $(which redwoodctl))` should say ELF), or 2) override PATH so `/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin` appears before any /mnt/c paths, or 3) explicitly run `/home/rachel/.linuxbrew/Cellar/redwoodctl/1.6.0/bin/redwoodctl` if present. For device auth in WSL, use `redwoodctl login --no-browser` so you can paste the code into the Windows browser and then `redwoodctl login --device --skip-auto-open` in WSL to poll.

ben: Also add a small `redwoodctl doctor` warning: "You are running the Windows binary under WSL; profiles and auth may not work." We should detect PE headers vs ELF and print this.

rachel: Quick fix: `sudo apt remove redwoodctl` (removed the native package), then `brew unlink redwoodctl && brew install --build-from-source ./redwoodctl-1.6.0.tar.gz` and verified `file $(which redwoodctl)` shows ELF. `redwoodctl profile list` now shows my profiles and `redwoodctl login --no-browser` completed.

omar: Filing DEVEX-4310: "WSL/Homebrew shim: detect Windows exe symlinks, doctor check, and add CLI docs for WSL login --no-browser workflow."

devex-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-4310 and added the repro steps and suggested doctor text.

rachel: Thanks everyone, will add notes to the internal onboarding doc so new hires don't trip over this. :sparkles:
